address: Hotel Bellevue, Pera Čingrije 7, Dubrovnik, 20000, Croatia
bio: One of the main attractions of this restaurant in the luxurious Bellevue Hotel is the superb sea view that can be enjoyed from its terrace and through the large windows in its dining room. Another is the fresh Mediterranean cuisine on offer here, which includes a delicious sea bream ceviche served with marinated citrus fruit, salmon roe and crispy quinoa chips....
